pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal regions with softened, smooth pixel-gradient edges. Patch color is a medium-saturation tawny brown. Spatial area of individual patches decreases monotonically from the upper neck/shoulder region toward the ventral and posterior sections.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous off-white interstitial network. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial. The pixel thickness of the pathways is relatively uniform across the mid-flank, with increased frequency of intersections on the lower haunch.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the upper neck and shoulder. The mane appears as a short, dense geometric fringe against the blurred background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct vertical linear mark/indentation is visible on the mid-lateral flank. A prominent rounded protrusion (skin nodule or tag) is visible on the ventral midline near the base of the chest.
other_distinctive_markers: The ventral protrusion serves as a high-contrast structural landmark for identification.
